name: Led Zeppelin

whyMatters.en: London four-piece that scaled blues and folk forms to arena hard rock; Led Zeppelin II–IV and Physical Graffiti remain the citation set for riff weight and dynamic range.
whyMatters.zh: 伦敦四人组：把蓝调与民谣形式扩到体育场 hard rock；Led Zeppelin II–IV 与 Physical Graffiti 仍是 riff 重量与动态幅度的引用集。

note.en: Theremin breakdown inside hard-rock single form.
note.zh: Hard-rock 单曲形式内的 theremin 崩解段。
原声到电声弧线成为 FM 点播模板。

note.en: Ostinato epic with non-blues modal color (Kashmir).
note.zh: 固定音型史诗与非蓝调调式色彩（Kashmir）。

interviewQuotes.text: I think when you hear that drum sound, you know it's Bonzo.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Jimmy Page

interviewQuotes.text: We were just four people who got together and happened to be very good.
interviewQuotes.speaker: Robert Plant

lyricQuotes: If there's a bustle in your hedgerow, don't be alarmed now
You need cooling, baby, I'm not fooling

shortBio.en: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham hard rock; Whole Lotta Love and Stairway are the twin poles.
shortBio.zh: Page / Plant / Jones / Bonham 的 hard rock；Whole Lotta Love 与 Stairway 是两极。

body.en:
Formed 1968 from Yardbirds residue. Early albums document Page’s production, Bonham’s drums, Jones’s arrangements, Plant’s high register—studio and stage as one system.

Whole Lotta Love (1969), Stairway to Heaven (1971), Kashmir (1975) show theremin breakdown, acoustic-to-electric arc, and ostinato epic. Stable classic-IV lineup is itself a historical fact in a scene of churn.
body.zh:
1968 年由 Yardbirds 残余组建。早期专辑记录 Page 制作、Bonham 鼓、Jones 编曲、Plant 高音区——录音室与舞台同一系统。

Whole Lotta Love（1969）、Stairway to Heaven（1971）、Kashmir（1975）展示 theremin 崩解段、原声到电声弧线与固定音型史诗。经典四人稳定阵容本身即人事动荡场景中的历史事实。

body.en:
Zeppelin matter as a closed instrumental economy: Page’s guitar/production, Plant’s vocal, Jones’s bass/keys/arranging, Bonham’s drums. Blues and folk sources are scaled, not merely covered.

Arena hard rock’s default grammar—riff + dynamic swing—gets a durable catalog here.
body.zh:
Zeppelin 要紧处是封闭的乐器经济：Page 吉他/制作、Plant 人声、Jones 贝斯/键盘/编曲、Bonham 鼓。蓝调与民谣来源被扩写，而非仅翻唱。

体育场 hard rock 的默认语法——riff + 动态摆动——在此留下耐久目录。

title.en: Classic IV with almost no churn
title.zh: 几乎无更替的经典四人

body.en:
Unlike many peers, the peak version is one cast. Session origins (Page, Jones) explain arrangement density; Bonham’s death ends the original run.

Lineup stability is part of why the silhouette stays sharp.
body.zh:
与许多同辈不同，巅峰版本几乎是一套人马。录音室出身（Page、Jones）解释编曲密度；Bonham 去世结束原班运行。

阵容稳定是剪影清晰的原因之一。

title.zh: 分工：吉他/制作、人声、编曲、鼓

body.en:
Page builds parts and mixes; Plant carries melody and lyric myth frames; Jones supplies bass, keys, and charts; Bonham supplies the groove weight later metal cites.

Four roles, few substitutes—configuration as method.
body.zh:
Page 写分声部并混音；Plant 扛旋律与歌词神话框架；Jones 提供贝斯、键盘与谱面；Bonham 提供后来金属常引的 groove 重量。

四个角色、极少替补——编制即方法。

title.en: Whole Lotta Love: riff then breakdown
title.zh: Whole Lotta Love：先 riff 后崩解

body.en:
Open riff, Plant’s vocal, then theremin/feedback middle before the return. Hard rock learns mid-song studio drama without prog suite length.

Body-first listening: the drop is structural, not ornamental.
body.zh:
开放 riff、Plant 人声，然后 theremin/反馈中段再返回。Hard rock 学到曲中录音室戏剧，却不走 prog 组曲时长。

身体优先的听法：落下是结构，不是装饰。

title.en: Stairway: acoustic climb to hard ending

body.en:
Fingerpicked opening, layered guitars, then Bonham’s entry and solo section. FM radio turns a long form into a request-line standard.

Dynamic narrative—folk start, heavy finish—becomes a teaching template.
body.zh:
指弹开场、多层吉他，然后 Bonham 进入与独奏段。FM 电台把长曲变成点播标准。

动态叙事——民谣起、重型收——成为教学模板。

body.en:
Interview and lore lines stress chemistry over costume. The useful claim is musical: arrangement and performance lock, not mystique for its own sake.

Read quotes as production notes in oral form.
body.zh:
访谈与传说强调化学作用而非戏服。有用的主张是音乐上的：编曲与演奏锁定，而非为神秘而神秘。

把引语当口述形式的制作笔记。

title.en: Answers: metal, punk refusal, grunge weight
title.zh: 回应：金属、朋克拒绝、grunge 重量

body.en:
NWOBHM and metal inherit riff weight; punk often refuses the excess; grunge keeps the sludge and drops the fantasy lyric.

Zeppelin remain a reference to salute, sample, or overthrow.
body.zh:
NWOBHM 与金属继承 riff 重量；朋克常拒绝其过量；grunge 留下淤泥并丢掉奇幻歌词。

Zeppelin 仍是致敬、采样或推翻的参照。

note.en: Stable peak version—minimal churn, maximal catalog citation.
note.zh: 稳定巅峰版本——更替极少，目录引用最多。

note.en: Early riff weight as hard-rock teaching track.
note.zh: 早期 riff 重量作为 hard-rock 教学曲。

note.en: Blues/folk forms scaled to arena; metal and grunge still answer the catalog.
note.zh: 蓝调/民谣形式扩到体育场；金属与 grunge 仍回应此目录。
